render.adr: ADR-0245 clause 2: one n per element, from data-tier, data-scale, size and data-density
render.selector: ui-button, ui-toggle, ui-text-field, ui-select, ui-combo-box, ui-card
render.measure: the element's cascade n (its --md-sys-height / 4)
render.expect: resolve(register).n, the register read from the element's own and its ancestors' attributes

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 5 items 1 and 2 (Amendment 3 for button and toggle); a square entry cell (otp-field) is not a pill: see entry-cell-radius (Amendment 6); the segmented control joined in T-0144 (T-0138: single-line controls in one row share h/2)
render.selector: ui-button, ui-toggle, ui-text-field:not([multiline]), ui-select > [data-part='trigger'], ui-combo-box > [data-part='editor'], ui-badge, ui-segmented-control
render.measure: border-start-start-radius against the box height

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 3 (geometry.md: icon-only, no label, is square)
render.selector: ui-button with an icon and no label text
render.measure: box width against box height

render.adr: ADR-0245 M5: no type below CFG.floor
render.selector: every element with its own visible text
render.measure: font-size; a glyph is not text (ADR-0245 Amendment 6): ui-glyph and the glyph parts are skipped here and checked by glyph-box

render.adr: T-0130: nothing past the content column at 400px
render.selector: every element inside the content column
render.measure: box right edge against the column's right edge + 4px, unless an overflow-x frame holds it

render.adr: ADR-0046 and the dogfood rule: a card is never the direct content of a card
render.measure: the nearest ancestor ui-card

render.adr: ADR-0245 clause 3: a single-line control is 4n tall
render.measure: box height

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 4: the text edge is 2n - c (margin n plus label inset n - c)
render.measure: host padding-inline-start + the text slot's padding-inline-start

render.adr: ADR-0245 clause 3: a card takes its level radius
render.measure: border-start-start-radius

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 5 item 3: a listbox panel is concentric, the row pill 2n plus the inset c
render.measure: border-start-start-radius (only when the panel has a box)

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): a badge is a display atom and hugs its label; a stretching column parent never widens it into a bar
render.measure: box width against the badge's max-content width

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): a multi-select option shows its toggle in both states, so the control reads as choosable before the first click
render.measure: the option's ::before box (the indicator)
render.expect: width > 0 in the unselected and the selected state

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): a ui-text link or span nested in running text shares the paragraph's line box
render.selector: p > ui-text[as='a'], p > ui-text[as='span'], ui-text > ui-text[as='a'], ui-text > ui-text[as='span']
render.measure: computed display (truncate excepted)

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): adjacent trailing adornments (a suffix and the step cells) never glue; ADR-0245 Amendment 4's control gap c
render.measure: the gap between each pair of adjacent visible children of the trailing cell

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 6: a square entry cell is a round square at radius n, never the pill h/2 (a circle)
render.measure: border-start-start-radius

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 6: icon and glyph are distinct; a glyph sits in its own glyph box 2n - 2c
render.measure: the visible glyph box, both axes

render.adr: T-0141 (review part-c, gauge): under non-scaling-stroke the browser reads a dash pattern in screen px, so a viewBox-unit pattern repeats as scattered dashes
render.measure: computed vector-effect and stroke-dasharray
render.expect: never non-scaling-stroke together with a dasharray other than none

render.adr: T-0141 (review part-c, breadcrumb): an anchor inside a fleet control takes the control's ink, never the browser's default link colour
render.measure: the anchor's computed color

render.adr: T-0139 (the fleet disabled recipe, review part-a): a disabled control is always quieter than the same control enabled
render.measure: the ink's contrast against the control's composited fill, disabled and with the disabled attribute lifted

render.adr: T-0139 (review part-c, pagination): a disabled ghost stays unfilled; a grey pill beside the current page reads as pressed
render.measure: the computed background (colour and image)

render.adr: T-0139 (review part-b, switch): a disabled track, box or ring keeps its silhouette against the surface
render.measure: the better of the fill and the border (over the fill), each composited over the surface, against the surface

render.adr: T-0139 (review part-b, toggle): a disabled unpressed toggle keeps the enabled unpressed fill, so it never reads as pressed
render.measure: the composited background, disabled and with the disabled attribute lifted

render.adr: T-0139 (button.css): a ui-text label inside a button takes the button's ink, so the variant and the disabled recipe show
render.measure: the ui-text's computed color against its ui-button's

render.adr: T-0140 (review part-b, avatar): the initials disc separates from the page
render.measure: the disc (its flat gradient plane over its base, over the surface) against the surface behind the avatar

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, product-card): a badge over an image has its own opaque pill and readable ink, whatever the photo
render.selector: an absolutely positioned ui-badge whose box overlaps an img, ui-image or [data-part='image']
render.measure: the badge's own layers, flattened without the backdrop, and its ink against them

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, composer pickers): a button with no visible glyph and no visible label looks broken
render.measure: the painted boxes of its icons, glyphs and svgs, and the rendered width of its text
render.expect: an icon box or a text run wider than 0

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, CardTable): the buttons of one action group share a line or wrap together, never one at a time
render.selector: a flex row holding two or more ui-buttons and at least one other visible child
render.measure: the buttons' top edges, and which line each shares with a non-button sibling
render.expect: every button on one line, or no button on a line with a non-button sibling

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, containers.css): a note under a specimen or a button never sits flush against it
render.selector: p after a visible element sibling that is not a text block
render.measure: the p's top edge against the sibling's bottom edge

render.adr: T-0138 (review part-a, game-hud and result-card): a stat glyph sits n clear of its label (the chip gap)
render.selector: ui-game-hud [data-part='glyph'], ui-result-card [data-part='glyph'], with a visible next sibling
render.measure: the inline gap from the glyph to its next sibling

render.adr: T-0138 (review part-b, icon demo): at 400px no demo card is cut by its scroller with no scroll cue
render.selector: ui-card inside an overflow-x frame that is neither a ui-* control nor one of its parts
render.measure: the card's right edge against the frame's right edge

compose.adr: T-0135: a date is a real input
compose.use: ui-text-field type=date (A2UI: a TextField of type date)
compose.not: a ui-calendar inside a ui-popover, or beside a calendar-icon ui-button, standing in for a date field (A2UI: a Calendar inside a Popover or FormPopover)
compose.detect: a file that creates ui-calendar and also ui-popover, ui-form-popover or an icon=calendar ui-button; a payload whose Popover or FormPopover lists a Calendar child

compose.adr: ADR-0243: a board of cells is ui-board-grid
compose.not: a ui-grid of cell ui-buttons (A2UI: a Grid whose children are all Buttons)
compose.detect: a payload Grid with three or more explicit children that are all Buttons, or a template child that is a Button; a file that appends ui-buttons into a ui-grid inside a loop

compose.adr: ADR-0245 clause 1: every margin, gutter, radius, height and type size derives from n
compose.use: the derived tokens and the control's own size or the container's data-* register
compose.not: an inline style that sets padding, margin, gap, radius, height or font-size to a literal length
compose.detect: .style.<prop> = '<length>', .style.cssText, .style.setProperty('<prop>', '<length>'), a style="..." attribute or a style: '...' key, for a geometry property with a px, rem or em literal other than 0 and the 1px hairline
